uses.action: Perform a family cadence whose words are missing, or invite Sefa to voice a named hill line. Change the fourth beat to hear who can carry the tune after Teodora.
Pull separate cords for earliest departure, leadership and first arrival at two moments. A runner, a baton bearer and a porter can each answer to first.
Carry the issued procession to the island. Choose a departure pennant or the conductor’s stand. A different person can act on the new meaning of first.
Compare the three numbered ticket lifts in packets that differ on one setting. Publish a first arrangement with its individual results still visible to the next maker.
Bring the issued paper ticket to the next workshop. Put another sheet into service or display the batch-specific sample where a visitor can ask for the others.
